title: hieracium dermophyllum subsp. ortiganum
intro: Hieracium dermophyllum subsp. ortiganum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential to provide relief from fever, inflammation, and skin conditions due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antihistamine properties, making it a valuable treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
